$comment: Visit counters per Vite mode (docs/PLAN.md, section 17). Both values are public. Empty means off; with both empty the page asks nothing of anyone but OpenStreetMap. cloudflareToken is the token of a Cloudflare Web Analytics site (32 hex characters, manual snippet, never the automatic injection); googleMeasurementId is a Google Analytics 4 measurement id (G-...), loaded only after the visitor accepts. Modes not listed have no counters.
